what: The cue sheet of one verified rehearsal: apps/desktop/scripts/demo-worker.mjs --private --headless --scene both --gap 20 --pace normal (a throwaway engine, no Knack app, so no ring was drawn). at_s is seconds since the start. A headed run at --pace slow takes longer; use the printed times of the real take, not these.

rows.msg: throwaway engine on 127.0.0.1:<free port> (own home and data directory; no desktop app, so no ring is drawn)
person p_learn01, scene both, pace normal (x1), headless
sandbox lock held (<repo>/data/locks)
sandbox sites reset (notes, submissions and counters cleared)
coach set to the first help level on the cliff skill (study mode, cleared at the end): status 200
Chromium with the capture extension is up (capture on for p_learn01; events go to 127.0.0.1:<free port>)
COACH: a teammate works a case and skips the cliff check
CASE-1005: household entered on calculator A, result on screen
MISS: switches to the case note without opening "Check cliff edges"
back on the result page, the cliff check still unopened
coach decides annotate, level L1, trigger expert_policy, zone cliff_button
the coach decided to ring the skipped step: 4 s after the miss
the ring should now be on "Check cliff edges" (drawn by the Knack app, not by this script)
presses "Check cliff edges"; the panel lists the nearby edges
CASE-1005: case note filled in
CASE-1005: case note saved as a DRAFT (the worker never presses Submit)
20 s of quiet, so the engine's cooldown after the coach prompt has passed
study mode cleared before the stuck scene, so the coach is at the worker's own level

CASE-1006: household entered on calculator A, result on screen
presses "Check cliff edges"; the panel lists the nearby edges
CASE-1006: case note filled in
STALL: the note is filled in and the worker hovers over it for up to 75 s without saving (Cue's gate wants two quiet stuck readings)
cue decides cue (step verify_note)
Cue decided to speak during the stall: cue on verify_note, 46 s into the stall
Cue should now be on screen (drawn by the Knack app, not by this script); the worker takes the step it names
cue decides cue (step verify_note)
CASE-1006: case note saved as a DRAFT (the worker never presses Submit)
the script ran to the end
